blocking_methods.label: tollFree
blocking_methods.instructions: Call 1800 425 4000 and follow the IVR to hotlist the card.
SMS Call our customer care number 0497 2717800 from the registered mobile number and follow the IVR instructions.
Email customercare.kgb@kgb.bank.in from your registered email to request card blocking.
Log in to internet banking at https://netbanking.kgb.bank.in and use the card block/hotlist option.
Block via the bank's mobile app (Cards > Block/Hotlist). Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.npst.kgbinfi&hl=en_IN | iOS: https://apps.apple.com/in/app/kgb-infi/id6740206250
SMS Send SMS to 9230600500 in the format HOTLIST + last four digits of the ATM Card Number (page example: HOTLIST 1234). from your registered mobile number.

Lost-card FAQ on the RuPay debit-card page: 'Immediately Hotlist / Block your Debit Card by calling 0497 2717800'; SMS self-service HOTLIST + last four digits of the ATM card number to 9230600500; IVR hotlist by calling customer care 0497 2717800 from the registered mobile number; mobile-banking users block inside the app ('KGB mPAY application.. Click on ATM card Menu >> click Temporary Block/Unblock >> Use toggle button to block debit card usage'); or inform the branch to hotlist the card. The site header publishes Toll Free Number 1800 425 4000 (this number is also the published WhatsApp banking number, 1800-425-4000) and Customer Care Number 0497-2717800; no service hours are published for either line and no overseas number is published. KGBNet internet banking (netbanking.kgb.bank.in) offers 'hot-listing of Debit Card' under its online Request Services — 'Debit card can be hot-listed online. User will receive the status over SMS to the registered Mobile Number' — and is advertised as 24 X 7 banking; the KGB INFI mobile app is advertised as 24/7. The site's published app-store links point to KGB INFI as the bank's mobile banking app ('Available for both Android and iOS users'), while the blocking FAQ still names the older KGB mPAY app; no store link labelled mPAY is published. Customer-care email is published in the contact page's structured data as customercare.kgb@kgb.bank.in (also shown obfuscated as customercare[dot]kgb[at]kgb[dot]bank[dot]in); the complaints portal is connect.kgb.bank.in. No mention of the 1930 cyber helpline appears on the bank's checked pages.

No credit-card product or credit-card blocking channel is published: the site's Cards menu lists only RuPay Debit Cards, Junior Debit Card and Kisan Credit Card (a farm-loan card), /personal-banking/credit-cards and /personal-banking/credit-card returned 404 in the same live check, and the only 'credit card' wording on the debit page is generic CVV-copy. The earlier entry's credit-card channels (toll-free 1800-425-1829, customercare@keralagbank.in) appear nowhere on the current official site; the bank's published care lines under 'debit' are its card-blocking channels.
